Model selection results

Source: R/methods.R
model_selection.Rd

Returns, for each cohort, the selection statistics of all fitted models (SSE, BIC, BIC3 and, depending on the method, the WBIC weight and value or the modified BIC; for Poisson and binomial fits the deviance and dispersion, the criteria using the deviance divided by the dispersion), R squared and the Durbin-Watson statistic (undefined for constant series and exact fits), the permutation or likelihood ratio tests performed, the data dependent selection details and the MADWD steps.

Usage

model_selection(object)

Arguments

object

A joinpoint object.

Value

A list with data frames criteria, tests, dds and madwd (the last three may be NULL), and selected with the selected number of joinpoints per cohort.

Examples

tb <- subset(us_mortality, cause == "Tuberculosis")
fit <- joinpoint(tb, year, rate, kmax = 2, ci_method = "parametric")
model_selection(fit)$criteria
#>   joinpoints       sse       bic      bic3    weight      wbic df        mse
#> 1          0 14.763921 -1.810103 -1.810103        NA -1.810103 97 0.15220537
#> 2          1  3.220021 -3.240071 -3.193655 0.7818994 -3.203779 95 0.03389496
#> 3          2  1.068503 -4.250369 -4.157538 0.9336905 -4.163694 93 0.01148928
#>   r_squared durbin_watson selected
#> 1 0.9645795    0.03403132    FALSE
#> 2 0.9922748    0.13868568    FALSE
#> 3 0.9974365    0.37665278     TRUE
